title: Disagree and recap in an international meeting
summary: Phản biện lịch sự, xử lý câu hỏi tiếp theo và chốt quyết định có owner.

sections.title: Meeting proposal
sections.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Proposal: skip the three-hour load test to keep Friday's launch. Current evidence: staging has handled only 20% of forecast traffic. Minh can run the critical scenario from 13:00 to 16:00. Lan is the release owner; rollback ownership is not assigned.

exercises.question: Mở đầu nào phản biện rõ nhưng không đối đầu?
options: I see the schedule concern; I’m not comfortable skipping the load test because staging covers only 20% of forecast traffic.
correctAnswer: I see the schedule concern; I’m not comfortable skipping the load test because staging covers only 20% of forecast traffic.
exercises.explanation: Acknowledge mục tiêu chung rồi nêu concern kèm evidence.

performanceTask.title: Challenge and close the decision
performanceTask.scenario: Trong cuộc họp release, nhóm muốn bỏ một quality gate để giữ deadline.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Trong 60–90 giây, dựa trên meeting evidence đang hiển thị và phản hồi mà chưa xem model hoặc chunk bank.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Trong 60–90 giây, acknowledge mục tiêu, nêu disagreement có evidence, đề xuất phương án và recap owner/deadline như một proposal chưa được xác nhận.
performanceTask.modelResponse: I understand why we want to protect Friday’s date. I’m concerned about skipping the load test because staging has covered only twenty percent of forecast traffic. Could we run the critical scenario from one to four today and make launch conditional on the result? My proposal is that Minh runs that scenario by four. Lan is the release owner, but rollback ownership is still unassigned, so I propose that Lan confirms a rollback owner before we decide to proceed. To recap, those are proposed actions, not agreed assignments: Minh could run the test by four, and the release owner still needs to confirm rollback ownership.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Trong 60–90 giây, dùng retry evidence mới, sửa tiêu chí trọng tâm và kết thúc bằng proposed decision recap rõ ràng.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Trong 60–90 giây, dùng security-review evidence, phản biện và recap phương án thay thế mà không xem model/chunks.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Trong 60–90 giây, dùng accessibility evidence mới và đề xuất owner/deadline mà không xem model/chunks.

rubric.label: Constructive tone
rubric.description: Acknowledges the shared goal before disagreeing.

rubric.label: Evidence and alternative
